node.label: Party politics & State elections
node.summary: Party splits, alliances and preparations for upcoming State elections.

facts.text: The BMC pulled actor **Dia Mirza's** eco-friendly Deepavali video after BJP objections; Mumbai Mayor: **Ritu Tawde**.
facts.plain: The BMC pulled actor Dia Mirza's eco-friendly Deepavali video after BJP objections; Mumbai Mayor: Ritu Tawde.

facts.text: Punjab BJP president: **Kewal Singh Dhillon**. Punjab's Assembly election is due in early **2027**.
facts.plain: Punjab BJP president: Kewal Singh Dhillon. Punjab's Assembly election is due in early 2027.

facts.text: Congress (Kharge, Rahul Gandhi, K.C. Venugopal) reviewed preparations for the 2027 elections in **Uttarakhand** and **Manipur**.
facts.plain: Congress (Kharge, Rahul Gandhi, K.C. Venugopal) reviewed preparations for the 2027 elections in Uttarakhand and Manipur.

facts.text: Karnataka 'sting video' row: Union Minister **H.D. Kumaraswamy** vs CM **D.K. Shivakumar** over a video aimed at ex-CM Siddaramaiah.
facts.plain: Karnataka 'sting video' row: Union Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy vs CM D.K. Shivakumar over a video aimed at ex-CM Siddaramaiah.

facts.text: **Ajit Pawar** died in a helicopter crash earlier in 2026; Sunetra Pawar now heads the NCP.
facts.plain: Ajit Pawar died in a helicopter crash earlier in 2026; Sunetra Pawar now heads the NCP.

facts.text: NCP: six leaders (Praful Patel, Sunil Tatkare, Chhagan Bhujbal, Dhananjay Munde, Hasan Mushrif, Dilip Walse Patil) met Amit Shah over the 'authoritarian' style of party president **Sunetra Pawar** (Maharashtra Deputy CM) and son Parth.
facts.plain: NCP: six leaders (Praful Patel, Sunil Tatkare, Chhagan Bhujbal, Dhananjay Munde, Hasan Mushrif, Dilip Walse Patil) met Amit Shah over the 'authoritarian' style of party president Sunetra Pawar (Maharashtra Deputy CM) and son Parth.

facts.text: UP: Samajwadi Party's **PDA** = Pichhda, Dalit, Alpsankhyak; Akhilesh Yadav now adds 'Pandit' and 'Agarwal'. SP won **5 of 11** MLC seats, BJP the rest.
facts.plain: UP: Samajwadi Party's PDA = Pichhda, Dalit, Alpsankhyak; Akhilesh Yadav now adds 'Pandit' and 'Agarwal'. SP won 5 of 11 MLC seats, BJP the rest.

facts.text: West Bengal's government notified Group D government jobs for one family member of each person killed in political violence over the preceding 25 years (income cutoff ₹50,000/month), a day after CM Suvendu Adhikari's announcement in Paschim Medinipur.
facts.plain: West Bengal's government notified Group D government jobs for one family member of each person killed in political violence over the preceding 25 years (income cutoff ₹50,000/month), a day after CM Suvendu Adhikari's announcement in Paschim Medinipur.

facts.text: Two MLAs — former AAP Minister **Chetan Singh Jouramajra** and **Harmeet Singh Pathanmajra** — resigned from AAP's primary membership ahead of the 2027 Punjab Assembly election.
facts.plain: Two MLAs — former AAP Minister Chetan Singh Jouramajra and Harmeet Singh Pathanmajra — resigned from AAP's primary membership ahead of the 2027 Punjab Assembly election.

facts.text: BJP, led by Delhi CM Rekha Gupta and Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri, held a rally demanding a Congress apology for the **1984 anti-Sikh riots**, held opposite the INDIA bloc's Ramlila Maidan rally.
facts.plain: BJP, led by Delhi CM Rekha Gupta and Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri, held a rally demanding a Congress apology for the 1984 anti-Sikh riots, held opposite the INDIA bloc's Ramlila Maidan rally.

facts.text: **Hardeep Singh Puri** filed his papers for the **12 Nov** Madhya Pradesh Rajya Sabha by-election, with CM **Mohan Yadav** and BJP State chief **Hemant Khandelwal**.
facts.plain: Hardeep Singh Puri filed his papers for the 12 Nov Madhya Pradesh Rajya Sabha by-election, with CM Mohan Yadav and BJP State chief Hemant Khandelwal.

facts.text: The **RSS** holds a three-day national meeting in **Indore** (from 2 Nov) with **408** functionaries, in its **centenary year** (RSS founded **1925**, Nagpur, by **K.B. Hedgewar**). Chief **Mohan Bhagwat**, general secretary **Dattatreya Hosabale**, publicity in-charge **Sunil Ambekar**.
facts.plain: The RSS holds a three-day national meeting in Indore (from 2 Nov) with 408 functionaries, in its centenary year (RSS founded 1925, Nagpur, by K.B. Hedgewar). Chief Mohan Bhagwat, general secretary Dattatreya Hosabale, publicity in-charge Sunil Ambekar.

facts.text: AAP released its first list of **40** candidates (all sitting MLAs) for the Punjab election: CM **Bhagwant Mann** from **Dhuri** (Sangrur), Speaker **Kultar Singh Sandhwan** from Kotkapura. Punjab has **117** seats; AAP won **92** in 2022; the Assembly's term ends **16 March 2027**.
facts.plain: AAP released its first list of 40 candidates (all sitting MLAs) for the Punjab election: CM Bhagwant Mann from Dhuri (Sangrur), Speaker Kultar Singh Sandhwan from Kotkapura. Punjab has 117 seats; AAP won 92 in 2022; the Assembly's term ends 16 March 2027.

facts.text: Bihar Health Minister **Nishant Kumar**, son of former CM and JD(U) chief **Nitish Kumar**, will address a JD(U) conclave in **Varanasi** ahead of the U.P. poll.
facts.plain: Bihar Health Minister Nishant Kumar, son of former CM and JD(U) chief Nitish Kumar, will address a JD(U) conclave in Varanasi ahead of the U.P. poll.

facts.text: Meghalaya: **UDP** president **Metbah Lyngdoh** resigned as a Minister after **11 of the party's 12 MLAs** quit, leaving him its only MLA. CM: **Conrad K. Sangma** (NPP).
facts.plain: Meghalaya: UDP president Metbah Lyngdoh resigned as a Minister after 11 of the party's 12 MLAs quit, leaving him its only MLA. CM: Conrad K. Sangma (NPP).

facts.text: BJP named Petroleum Minister **Hardeep Singh Puri** for the Madhya Pradesh **Rajya Sabha by-election (12 Nov)** after **L. Murugan** resigned his seat; M.P. Congress chief **Jitu Patwari** raised Puri's alleged Epstein links.
facts.plain: BJP named Petroleum Minister Hardeep Singh Puri for the Madhya Pradesh Rajya Sabha by-election (12 Nov) after L. Murugan resigned his seat; M.P. Congress chief Jitu Patwari raised Puri's alleged Epstein links.

facts.text: **Yogi Adityanath** was a five-term MP from Gorakhpur and is now MLA from **Gorakhpur (Urban)**; PM Modi is in his third term as MP from **Varanasi**.
facts.plain: Yogi Adityanath was a five-term MP from Gorakhpur and is now MLA from Gorakhpur (Urban); PM Modi is in his third term as MP from Varanasi.

facts.text: Punjab election (due Feb-March 2027): AAP (CM **Bhagwant Mann**, national convener **Arvind Kejriwal**, State in-charge **Manish Sisodia**, State chief **Aman Arora**) readies its first list; SAD chief **Sukhbir Singh Badal** promises ₹5/unit power for industry and a 'Build Punjab' department.
facts.plain: Punjab election (due Feb-March 2027): AAP (CM Bhagwant Mann, national convener Arvind Kejriwal, State in-charge Manish Sisodia, State chief Aman Arora) readies its first list; SAD chief Sukhbir Singh Badal promises ₹5/unit power for industry and a 'Build Punjab' department.

facts.text: ADR: **734 Registered Unrecognised Political Parties** reported ₹1,118.49 crore income in FY 2024-25; **29 RUPPs from Gujarat** reported the most (**₹510.41 crore**), then Delhi (₹218.48 crore, 73 parties) and Rajasthan (₹173.36 crore).
facts.plain: ADR: 734 Registered Unrecognised Political Parties reported ₹1,118.49 crore income in FY 2024-25; 29 RUPPs from Gujarat reported the most (₹510.41 crore), then Delhi (₹218.48 crore, 73 parties) and Rajasthan (₹173.36 crore).

facts.text: U.P. Lok Sabha history: BJP won **71** seats in 2014, **62** in 2019 and **33** in 2024, when the **SP won 37**. U.P.'s next Assembly election is due early **2027**; Akhilesh Yadav's **PDA** = Pichhda, Dalit, Alpsankhyak.
facts.plain: U.P. Lok Sabha history: BJP won 71 seats in 2014, 62 in 2019 and 33 in 2024, when the SP won 37. U.P.'s next Assembly election is due early 2027; Akhilesh Yadav's PDA = Pichhda, Dalit, Alpsankhyak.

facts.text: **Prashant Kishor** (Jan Suraaj founder) won the **Bankipur** by-election in August by 19,324 votes, a seat the BJP had held since 1995; Jan Suraaj won no seat in the 2025 Bihar Assembly election.
facts.plain: Prashant Kishor (Jan Suraaj founder) won the Bankipur by-election in August by 19,324 votes, a seat the BJP had held since 1995; Jan Suraaj won no seat in the 2025 Bihar Assembly election.

facts.text: Tamil Nadu is ruled by the **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)** with **C. Joseph Vijay** as Chief Minister; DMK chief **M.K. Stalin** condemned the brief detention of MIDS economist **A. Kalaiyarasan**.
facts.plain: Tamil Nadu is ruled by the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) with C. Joseph Vijay as Chief Minister; DMK chief M.K. Stalin condemned the brief detention of MIDS economist A. Kalaiyarasan.

facts.text: Punjab BJP's **Sunil Jakhar** asked Governor **Gulab Chand Kataria** to recommend early enforcement of the model code of conduct, alleging a law-and-order breakdown under CM **Bhagwant Mann**.
facts.plain: Punjab BJP's Sunil Jakhar asked Governor Gulab Chand Kataria to recommend early enforcement of the model code of conduct, alleging a law-and-order breakdown under CM Bhagwant Mann.
